svg.text: 40 FT HIGH CUBE CONTAINER - TOP OF CONTAINER = 8'-10" ABOVE GRADE
PEAK - RAFTER TOP EDGE, LEVEL FULL 40'-0"
(31) 2x12 RAFTERS @ 16" O.C., PLUMB CUT FLUSH AT NORTH FRAMING FACE
TOP PLATE (2) 2x6 ON THE BEVEL, 3" PERP.
EXTERIOR VIEW - LOOKING SOUTH - EAST END AT LEFT
1. DATUM = TOP OF CONTAINER = 8'-10" ABOVE GRADE.
2. ALL HEIGHTS THIS SHEET ARE ABOVE THAT DATUM.
3. RISER IS A STUD WALL - NO POSTS, NO BAYS.
4. WALL IS BEARING - RAFTERS LAND ON CAP PLATE.
5. VENT R.O.s SHOWN, FLAP UNITS NOT.
6. FLAPS CUT FROM FRESH PRO-PANEL, 1" LAP ALL ROUND.
2. STUD TOPS BEVEL CUT 4.5:12 - 5 7/8" ON THE CUT.
3. TOP PLATE (2) 2x6, 3" PERP., SET FLUSH NORTH.
4. PLATE 3/8" SHY OF STUD - BARE EDGE INTERIOR.
6. KING + TRIMMER OUTBOARD; (3) 2x6 PACK BETWEEN PAIR.
7. CRIPPLES OVER HEADER BEVEL-RIPPED TO PLATE SLOPE.
